citation.title: Characterization of cross-section correction to charge exchange recombination spectroscopy rotation measurements using co- and counter-neutral-beam views
citation.authors: W. M. Solomon; K. H. Burrell; R. Feder; A. Nagy; P. Gohil; R. J. Groebner

topic: Atomic-physics (energy-dependent charge-exchange cross-section) systematic corrections to CER carbon-impurity velocity on DIII-D
own_question: Can paired co- and counter-beam CER views experimentally determine the cross-section correction to impurity toroidal rotation and validate the calculated (ADAS-based) correction?
actual_method_and_evidence: The authors added seven counter-beam CER chords and used C VI 529 nm lines. They solved two measurements for two unknowns: toroidal velocity and the correction scalar. Results include example DIII-D discharges and a database of automated CERQUICK analyses. The authors report a tendency to overcorrect, with a median difference between corrected views of about 15%. They report that corrected views agree within 10 km/s at least 73% of the time. Analysis is offline. Temperature is not the target; rotation is.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Reported carbon CER quantities depend on atomic-physics modelling, so they are conventional processed labels rather than independent physical truth; one DIII-D study found calculated rotation corrections tend to overcorrect.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: Abstract; Sec. III last paragraph; Sec. IV
claim_checks.qualification: Applies to rotation (line shift) on DIII-D, not to Ti or KSTAR; the authors' explanation via the n=2 population is a hypothesis.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: The energy-dependent cross-section effect scales mainly with ion temperature and also depends on beam energy, beam fractions and excited-state populations.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: Sec. I; Sec. II first paragraph
claim_checks.qualification: Stated for the apparent velocity correction only.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not relevant; no timing, latency or nowcasting is addressed.
validation_if_relevant: Paired-view consistency check across a multi-condition database; neither view is an independent ground truth.
forbidden_inferences: Do not claim the paper quantifies CES Ti label error.
Do not transfer the 15% figure to KSTAR or to temperature.
Do not cite it as real-time or causal work.
Do not claim the n=2 enhancement is a demonstrated physical mechanism.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Include as brief support for treating CES reports as model-dependent labels. It is peripheral to the nowcasting method.
